## Appearance

Jane Andrews is described as neat, sensible, and plain in appearance. She is also noted for having a fat paw.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.Weddings P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)_

## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, plodding, and conscientious individual who possesses an unflappable nature and a materialistic streak, once remarking on the comforting value of diamonds. Skilled in domestic science, she has earned honors in the field. Her primary motivation is to dedicate her entire life to teaching for the paid salary, having resolved never to marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

During her schooldays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Jane Andrews belonged to the [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md). As she grew older, [Jane](../character/jane.md) attended a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), driven there by her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). She later prepared to become a teacher, debating methods of school discipline with her peers before taking up a teaching position. During her time in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she also participated in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), visiting local residents to advocate for community improvements. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was attending [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Jane](../character/jane.md) visited her room one evening to deliver a proxy marriage proposal on behalf of her shy brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md); when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) declined, [Jane](../character/jane.md) accepted the refusal with slight coldness before departing the next morning. [Jane](../character/jane.md) eventually taught school on the western prairies, and prior to Anne's final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), news arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) of Jane's upcoming marriage to a rich man.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +473 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) have been playmates and close friends since their early school days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). They regularly attend local social gatherings and events together, including school outings, hotel concerts, and farewell celebrations. Their bond is grounded in long-standing neighborhood companionship and shared youth.

- Friend of — playmates and close friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040), [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), +5 more</sub>

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) are brother and sister who attend social events together, such as driving [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends home from local concerts. Their relationship takes a practical turn when [Jane](../character/jane.md) acts as a reluctant messenger to deliver Billy's unromantic marriage proposal to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf. Although [Jane](../character/jane.md) receives Anne's refusal with slight coldness, she calmly accepts that her shy brother will simply pursue another match.

- Sibling of — brother and sister driving together to a concert  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013)</sub>

### [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) is Jane's father. While [Jane](../character/jane.md) maintains close ties with her family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), news of her eventual engagement to a wealthy suitor is shared among the local community.

- Saved by — caught her by her sash as she nearly fell overboard into the lake  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
